sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Soulblight Gravelords army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Soulblight Gravelords units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Choose an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Choose a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Grave lord | 15 | 150
Grave Prince | 35 | 250
Grave King | 55 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

This unit has WARD (4+).
Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved.

Arcane Vampire
-3DP
Change your hero's Move characteristic to 6". In addition, your hero gains the VAMPIRE and WIZARD (2) keywords and the following ability and regiment options:
Your Hero Phase
5

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, you receive 1 command point.

Regiment Options | Any DEATHRATTLE units.

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-4DP
FABLED HEIRLOOMS
Effect: When this unit is added to your Order of Battle, you can immediately give it 1 artefact of power.
Passive
-2DP
ACOLYTE OF NECROS
Effect: Each time this unit successfully casts a spell in your hero phase and the casting roll was an unmodified 10+, add 1 to this unit’s power level until the start of your next turn.
Your Hero Phase
-4DP
BEAST FORM
Effect: Pick 1 of the following units to be this unit’s beast form:
A Dire Wolves unit with 1 model.
A Fell Bats unit with 1 model.
Set up the beast form unit within 1" of this unit, then remove this unit from the battlefield.
The beast form unit can use MOVE and CORE abilities in your next movement phase.
If the beast form unit is destroyed, before it is removed from play, set up this unit on the battlefield once more within 1" of it.
In addition, in any combat phase before FIGHT abilities are used, or at the end of any turn, you can have the beast form unit transform back into this unit. If you do so, set up this unit within l" of the beast form unit and remove the beast form unit from the battlefield.
This ability can only be used by an INFANTRY hero.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
UNDEAD STEED: Many heroes of the grave are borne into battle upon steeds compelled to ride to war eternally in undeath.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Undead Steed’s Hooves
Companion | 3 | 5+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Change the Save characteristic to 5+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Battle Mount
-10DP
SPECTRAL PALANQUIN: Some of the more aloof champions of the Soulblight Gravelords are carried to battle on a palanquin borne by a procession of gheists.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Spectral Host's Blades
Companion | 10 | 4+ | 4+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 10".
Change the Health characteristic to 12.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: WAR MACHINE, FLY.
Battle Mount
-20DP
MIGHTY GRAVE BEAST: The strongest of Nagash’s servants may be granted a terrifying beast from the grave upon which to ride into battle, perhaps a powerful Zombie Dragon, shrieking Terrorgheist or fabled dread abyssal.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Mighty Grave Beast's Talons
Companion | 7 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 2
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Grave Beast’s Talons is 5.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 12".
Change the Health characteristic to 16.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: MONSTER, FLY.

sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.

-4DP

Shoot in combat, Companion | 10" | D6 | 2+ | 4+ | 1 | 2

sections.name: Path of The Undying
sections.text:
(SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Any Hero Phase
SIPHON SPIRIT
Declare: Pick a friendly non- HERO unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Allocate D3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made), then Heal (D3) this unit.
Passive
UNHOLY STRENGTH
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
PROTECTION OF SHYISH
Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
SHADOWY TRANSLOCATION
Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the balllefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
KEYWORDS | CORE
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
HEXED WEAPONS
Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ' All-out Attack' command for a friendly unit
COLD COMMANDER
Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the’ All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent to use that command.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
CURSE-BOUND SENTINEL
Effect: While this unit is wholly within friendly territory, unmodified save rolls of 4+ for it are always successful.
Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
ETERNAL CHAMPION
Declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
Effect: Roll 2D6. On a 7+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
